name: Klee
notes: Both sources: ATK% sands, Pyro DMG goblet, CRIT circlet, Normal Attack first (Charged Attacks). Game8's Hexerei build names 4pc A Day Carved from Rising Winds and Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds (her signature) as best; KQM lists A Day Carved first as well, then Crimson Witch, Marechaussee Hunter, Night of the Sky's Unveiling, Unfinished Reverie and Gilded Dreams, and a different weapon order (Reliquary of Truth, The Widsith, Cashflow Supervision, Tome of the Eternal Flow); Lost Prayer leads because Game8 names it best and KQM includes it. KQM's goblet allows ATK% beside Pyro DMG. The catalyst Normal and Charged Attacks use the elemental curve (1.8x at level 10). Neither source gives CRIT or ATK goals. ER 130: KQM lists Klee with one Pyro teammate at 125-140 and with two at 115-130, solo Pyro at 140-160.
